authorization: User requested sequential execution of the preceding experiment design; new files confined to this new experiment directory.
sequence: five frozen evaluations and portable replays

arithmetic.baseline: Frozen S2-C five seeds 17,29,43,71,101; equal mean sigmoid probability; official parser validity filter
arithmetic.historical_H: Reuse frozen original arithmetic coefficients and columns 3,4,5,6, including violation_fraction; exact prediction replay expected 741/798
arithmetic.extractor: Exact copy of final text_evidence_20261017/evidence.py; no changes
arithmetic.fit: Training OOF mean probabilities, logit clip1e-12; sum all candidate BCE +0.5*beta squared, L2=1, no intercept, fixed base coefficient1; raw features, deterministic Newton, no hyperparameter search
arithmetic.unknown: Zero evidence, not an error; equal candidate offsets preserve baseline choices

bootstrap.interpretation: descriptive on repeatedly used validation bank; not independent confirmation

arithmetic.OOF_caveat: Base predictions held out; residual fitted all OOF rows; fitted training accuracy is not an unbiased meta-model OOF estimate.

split.restriction: training bank only; confirmation not a new holdout for the already-trained base model

relation.development_sample: At most12 randomly selected screened questions per family
relation.confirmation_sample: At most25 randomly selected screened questions per family, inspect all four candidates; also20 random screen-negative questions; deduplicate actual question reading
relation.sampling_labels: Do not use final correctness or model scores for sampling or first-pass review
relation.first_review: Question and candidate relation fidelity, actual conflict versus unknown, self-correction, candidate differentiation; evidence spans required
relation.second_review: Reveal training final numeric labels only after first-pass annotations frozen; describe association, not model accuracy
relation.gate_caveat: Engineering thresholds, report denominators and intervals; sampling is stratified, not population precision/recall; global recall not estimated by20 negatives
relation.freeze: Any repair only on development; confirmation failures preserved, no repair/retest on same confirmation sample

limits: Numerical jobs serial, Torch4/interop1, BLAS1; bytecode disabled; each portable predictor <=16MiB; fresh startup+prediction+independent scoring measured locally, not reference Xeon certification
ai_disclosure: Codex implemented code and performs explicit recorded reading audit; no independent second human reviewer is claimed.
